q: "Why do you punish me in this way?" he asked.
"Ever since I joined the Storm Tribe I have served you loyally, fighting always by your side. What have I done to lose your trust?"
inference: 'he' resolved from surrounding narrative naming Elmal as speaker addressing Orlanth.

q: And Orlanth said to him, "I do not neglect you, Bright Friend. It is to you that I entrust the greatest task of all: the protection of my people while I am away. You must guard the Storm Realm, for surely our enemies will come here when they learn that I am gone.
note: entrusts Elmal to guard the Storm Realm

q: "Elmal, Elmal," it said, "You once loved me, but I was unfaithful to you.
Come with me, for I have made a safe place for the two of us. Leave these barbarians, and we will hide away until the darkness ends."
note: disguised as woman, urges Elmal to flee with her

q: Elmal answered Teller of Lies, saying, "You are not the woman I loved.
I am loyal to her, and would never betray her, no matter what temptation you offered. Begone."
note: refuses temptation, declares loyalty to his wife

q: "Elmal, Elmal," it wailed, "Your master, Orlanth, is as good as slain, defeated in the land of the dead."
"You must take his place as King of the Storm Tribe," Teller of Lies told him, "for Orlanth's day is done.
note: disguised as oracle, urges Elmal to seize Orlanth's throne
